name: Aspirin, low dose
description: Acetylsalicylic acid at antiplatelet dose, irreversibly acetylating platelet cyclooxygenase-1 for the platelet lifespan. Approved for secondary cardiovascular prevention; primary-prevention use has narrowed as bleeding risk was weighed against benefit.

systems.note: Irreversible platelet COX-1 inhibition reducing atherothrombotic events; the labelled indication.
Bleeding is the dose-limiting effect and the reason primary prevention narrowed.
Salicylate hepatotoxicity is documented at higher doses.
Renal effects at analgesic and higher doses.

monitors.why: Occult gastrointestinal blood loss is the common way this presents.
Chronic occult blood loss depletes iron before the haemoglobin falls.
Function is inhibited irreversibly; the count is what remains measurable.
